notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate (exit 0); evidence contract_checked, not an MHS-Device level. Model-authored (kind model) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware run and none is possible: the driver is simulated R0 with no hardware backend. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver was kept; the bridge imports gymnasium and falls back to the legacy gym package, which is what the upstream uses. The upstream stack (gym 0.9.1, mujoco-py 0.5.7, MuJoCo 1.31, Python 3.6; README.md:9-11) is not installed and the clone is never imported, so the fake backend (fake.py) is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in for MultiAgentEnv and was not compared with upstream MuJoCo; the sim backend (gym.make('run-to-goal-ants-v0')) was not run. The fake keeps the upstream Tuple action space (two 8-value Boxes) and Tuple observation space (two 122-value Boxes) but is kinematic (zero contact forces, no goal, fall or rendering logic); the fidelity contract declares F0 and the gaps disclose that. Two legacy multi-agent translations are disclosed in the gaps: the fake returns (observation, {}) because the bridge reads a reset two-tuple as (observation, info), and it sums the per-agent rewards and collapses the per-agent dones to the scalar fields of cap.world.step.v1, keeping the per-agent values in info. Warnings from the last run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset, seed and step (they are inherited from gym.Env, which is outside the clone, so the AST surface cannot see them; the names occur in the clone); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because a top-level Tuple action space gets structure but no per-element limits from the bridge (a documented simulation-only residual), so the suite awards CL2 although every other CL3 test passed; G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs ticks and the two seed inputs (bridge-derived, unitless). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings; every fact cites a text line of the clone. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; there is no x-cap and no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed (the stable report digest without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
